text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the fateful Japan Derby.
"Parcae"—did not show 0 cm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A massive crowd had gathered in the stands to witness the birth of this year's Derby Umamusume.
While the venue was buzzing with anticipation and excitement...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind the scenes before the race, the air was even more tense than in previous years.
The main reason for this was—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Air Shakur-san?
We're asking everyone for a quick comment
before the race, if you don't mind—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huuuh!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for intruding...!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Air Shakur is really irritated...

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"I guess that's how she normally is.
Well, I can understand being on edge
before an important race, but..."
choice_data_list: (No, she's feeling anxious.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her fate of defeat hasn't changed. Yet she still wants to win... The facts within her and her conflicting emotions might be wavering.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You've been staring at me for a while now... It's annoying.
If you've got something to say, spit it out."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch...
choice_data_list: (...What can I even do?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Pinpointing that 7 cm, and closing it down to 3 cm—it was all thanks to her effort. What words could I possibly offer someone like her?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I believe that doing what I need to do
will lead to connecting with her sincerely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What I must do as a Trainer. That is to clear away her anxieties and let her take on the race without any lingering worries.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If I'm gonna spend oxygen on noise, I'd rather spend it thinking until the very last moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just 3 cm... only 3 cm...
If this reaches zero—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Damn it, gotta start over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no time to hesitate.
If you want to be of help, you have no choice but to believe in yourself and take action.
choice_data_list: (There's something I need to tell her.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If those words carry true responsibility and resolve, Air Shakur will surely listen—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! "991031021222"...
You're in the damn way! Get lost already!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Are you gonna get on my nerves too...
'Parcae'?!"
choice_data_list: Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What's this, finally worked up the nerve?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Fine by me, I'll hear you out.
Tell me what's on your mind..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You wanna shut 'em up, don'tcha?
Getting stupidly irritated like that is unsightly.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Everything you've done was completely in vain.
So just obediently accept your fate, they say."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"No, would you choose words like that?
'The Derby is a once-in-a-lifetime chance, so make sure to enjoy it'...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You never know how it'll turn out until it's over.
Whether you panic or keep your cool, the race will start.
All that's left is to run.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What're you so freaked out about, huh...?
Spit it out.
choice_data_list: It's only natural to be scared.
It's completely normal to feel scared.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What you believe in with absolute certainty is showing you that you're about to lose.
It's only natural to be terrified.
choice_data_list: Data really is everything to you, isn't it?
Data is absolute for you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the world she sees... in reality,
that is the route that becomes 'historical fact.'
Even so—
choice_data_list: In my reality, you're the strongest!
In my reality, you're the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've only been watching over her for a short time.
Even so, I believe I understand her strength... and the solid foundation built beneath it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If our ways of interpreting the world differ, what we see
also changes. So I don't know if these words will truly
reach you. Even so...!"
choice_data_list: The you standing before me right now can transcend fate.
The you standing before me right now can transcend fate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Is that... all you have to say?
choice_data_list: Stand by your "pride" to the very end!
Hold fast to your pride!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
That's not proof of anything.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You should know this too. Words like that
are never going to truly convince me."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why did you butt heads with me?
You should've just left me alone like usual.
choice_data_list: I've got my pride too, after all.
I've got my own pride on the line, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I want you to believe in yourself.
I want you to believe in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Let's put an end to all these nightmares right here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Like I said, that kinda crap
doesn't mean a damn thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah......

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...It's time.
choice_data_list: (I'm sure the message got through.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I know.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm done dreaming—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After Air Shakur left, just as I was about to pack up the laptop...
choice_data_list: “991031021222” has disappeared...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, 'Parcae' had completed
its new calculations. Its answer was—
